'''Betolo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Valet|servant]] of the [[Dessain family]]. Though he wished to be member of the [[Dessain family]], he was instead made a [[Valet|servant]]. Eventually, he wished to accomplish something of his own before his [[Death/Legends|death]] and wanted to leave [[Zerist]], a place he considered wretched. Betolo helped [[Volnos Ryo]] kidnap [[Oma Dessain]], daughter of [[Eomin Dessain]], and later also tried to poison [[Lanoree Brock]]. However, [[Lanoree Brock]] found out about his role in the kidnapping.<ref name="Eruption" />
